description:
Returns Funding Sources settings configured at the company level.
Requires the `view_funding_sources_settings` granular permission on the Funding Sources tool.

data.description: Funding Source company settings response data.

company_id.description: Unique string identifier of the company these settings belong to. Matches the `{company_id}` path parameter of the settings endpoints.

enabled.description: Whether the Funding Sources tool is enabled for the company. Read-only. When false, create/list/update of funding sources and related resources is not allowed.

enable_project_level.description: Whether project-level allocations (project entitlements) are enabled for the company. Set via the PATCH settings endpoint's `enable_project_level` body field.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the company settings were last updated. Null until settings have been written.
